title: FDA Approves New Treatment for Pancreatic Cancer
subtitle: A new daily pill offers hope for patients by targeting a protein once thought impossible to treat.

summary.en: The US Food and Drug Administration has officially approved a new drug called daraxonrasib for pancreatic cancer. This daily pill targets a specific protein that fuels tumor growth. Clinical studies showed that patients taking the drug lived nearly twice as long as those on standard chemotherapy. Experts believe this development marks a significant shift in how doctors treat this aggressive disease. The drug will be sold under the brand name Rasonque.
summary.zh: 美國食品藥物管理局已正式核准一款名為 daraxonrasib 的胰臟癌新藥。這種每日服用的藥丸能鎖定助長腫瘤生長的特定蛋白質。臨床研究顯示，服用該藥物的患者存活期幾乎是接受標準化學治療患者的兩倍。專家認為，這項發展標誌著醫師治療這種侵襲性疾病的方式出現了重大轉變。該藥物將以 Rasonque 為品牌名稱銷售。

paragraphs.en: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has officially approved a new, groundbreaking drug for the most common form of pancreatic cancer. This decision provides a new option for patients facing one of the deadliest types of the disease. The drug, known as daraxonrasib and sold under the brand name Rasonque, is a daily pill designed to stop a mutated protein that helps tumors grow. For many years, scientists believed this protein could not be targeted by medicine, making this a major achievement for the medical community.
paragraphs.zh: 美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）已正式核准一款針對最常見胰臟癌類型的突破性新藥。這項決定為面臨此類致命疾病的患者提供了新選擇。該藥物成分為 daraxonrasib，以 Rasonque 為品牌名稱銷售，是一種每日服用的藥丸，旨在抑制一種助長腫瘤生長的突變蛋白質。多年來，科學家一直認為這種蛋白質無法透過藥物鎖定，因此這對醫學界而言是一項重大成就。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Health, the FDA gave the drug expedited approval, which means it was approved faster than usual to help patients in need. The agency noted that this approval came more than six months ahead of their original target date. Kyle Diamantas, the FDA’s acting commissioner, stated that it is the agency's fundamental duty to provide meaningful treatments to patients as quickly as possible.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報健康版》（The Guardian Health）報導，食品藥物管理局給予該藥物加速核准，這意味著為了協助有需要的患者，其審核速度比平時更快。該機構指出，此次核准比原定目標日期提前了六個多月。食品藥物管理局代理局長戴曼塔斯（Kyle Diamantas）表示，盡可能快速地為患者提供有效的治療是該機構的基本職責。

paragraphs.en: The approval follows strong results from a clinical trial called RASolute 302. As reported by MedPage Today, the study involved 500 patients whose cancer had already begun to spread and had stopped responding to other treatments. The results showed that patients taking the new drug lived for a median of 13.2 months, compared to only 6.7 months for those receiving standard chemotherapy. Additionally, patients on the new treatment experienced fewer severe side effects. Because of these positive results, some medical experts have described the drug as a "grand slam" for cancer research.
paragraphs.zh: 此次核准是基於一項名為 RASolute 302 的臨床試驗所展現的強勁成果。據《今日醫學網》（MedPage Today）報導，該研究涵蓋了 500 名癌症已開始擴散且對其他療法不再有反應的患者。結果顯示，服用新藥的患者中位存活期為 13.2 個月，而接受標準化學治療的患者僅為 6.7 個月。此外，接受新療法的患者出現嚴重副作用的情況較少。由於這些正面結果，一些醫學專家將此藥譽為癌症研究的「全壘打」。

paragraphs.en: Pancreatic cancer is widely considered one of the most difficult cancers to treat. The American Cancer Society estimates that about 67,000 new cases will be diagnosed in the United States this year, with more than 52,000 people expected to die from the disease. The five-year survival rate is currently very low, at about 13%. Because the cancer is often hard to detect before it spreads to other organs, new and effective treatments are urgently needed.
paragraphs.zh: 胰臟癌被廣泛認為是最難治療的癌症之一。美國癌症協會（American Cancer Society）估計，今年美國將診斷出約 6 萬 7 千例新病例，預計有超過 5 萬 2 千人將死於此病。目前的五年存活率非常低，僅約 13%。由於這種癌症在擴散至其他器官前往往難以察覺，因此迫切需要新的有效治療方法。

paragraphs.en: STAT News reports that the drug works by using a technology similar to "molecular glue" to bind with multiple types of the mutated protein. Andrew Ko, a medical oncologist at the University of California, San Francisco, called the approval a transformative development. He noted that it is the biggest advancement in the treatment of pancreatic cancer in decades. Brian Wolpin of the Dana-Farber Cancer Institute added that these results support the drug as the new standard of care for patients with advanced pancreatic cancer who have already tried other treatments.
paragraphs.zh: 《STAT 新聞》（STAT News）報導指出，該藥物利用類似「分子膠」的技術，與多種類型的突變蛋白質結合。舊金山加州大學（University of California, San Francisco）的腫瘤內科醫師高安德魯（Andrew Ko）稱此核准為變革性的發展。他指出，這是數十年來胰臟癌治療領域最大的進展。丹娜法伯癌症研究所（Dana-Farber Cancer Institute）的沃爾平（Brian Wolpin）補充說，這些結果支持將該藥物作為晚期胰臟癌且已嘗試過其他療法的患者之新標準治療方案。

paragraphs.en: The drug gained significant public attention earlier this year when former US Senator Ben Sasse shared his personal experience with the medication on the CBS program 60 Minutes. He explained that the drug helped reduce his pain. This public interest led the FDA to allow “expanded access”—a program that lets patients get early access to experimental medicines before they are fully approved—for those who met specific requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 該藥物在今年稍早時，因前美國參議員薩斯（Ben Sasse）在哥倫比亞廣播公司（CBS）節目《60 分鐘》（60 Minutes）中分享他使用該藥物的個人經驗，而受到大眾高度關注。他解釋說，該藥物有助於減輕他的疼痛。這項公眾興趣促使食品藥物管理局針對符合特定要求的患者，開放了「擴大取得」（expanded access）計畫，這是一項允許患者在實驗性藥物完全核准前，提前取得使用的機制。

paragraphs.en: While the results are promising, doctors are monitoring side effects. MedPage Today noted that the most common issue for patients was a skin rash. However, very few patients had to stop taking the drug due to these issues compared to those on chemotherapy. The manufacturer, Revolution Medicines, is based in California and is already looking into whether this technology could be used to treat other types of cancer, such as lung cancer.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管結果令人振奮，醫師們仍持續監控副作用。《今日醫學網》指出，患者最常見的問題是皮膚紅疹。然而，與接受化學治療的患者相比，因這些問題而必須停藥的患者非常少。製造商 Revolution Medicines 總部位於加州，目前正研究該技術是否可用於治療其他類型的癌症，例如肺癌。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, doctors are optimistic that this approval will lead to even more options for patients. While pancreatic cancer has been historically difficult to tackle, the success of this new drug provides proof that targeting the specific pathways that drive tumor growth is a successful strategy. As Rachna Shroff from the University of Arizona Cancer Center mentioned, this study checks all the boxes for what is considered an important and meaningful clinical outcome. With dozens of other experimental drugs currently in development, the medical community hopes that Rasonque is just the beginning of a new era in cancer care.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，醫師們樂觀地認為，此次核准將為患者帶來更多選擇。雖然胰臟癌在歷史上一直難以應對，但此新藥的成功證明了鎖定驅動腫瘤生長的特定路徑是一項成功的策略。正如亞利桑那大學癌症中心（University of Arizona Cancer Center）的什羅夫（Rachna Shroff）所言，這項研究符合所有被視為重要且具意義的臨床結果標準。隨著目前還有數十種實驗性藥物正在開發中，醫學界希望 Rasonque 僅是癌症照護新時代的開端。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A major, overwhelming success or achievement.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 巨大的成功、大滿貫（原指棒球術語，此處比喻極大的成就）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 原為棒球術語，此處引申為極大的成功。文中：some medical experts have described the drug as a "grand slam" for cancer research.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The usual or accepted medical treatment for a specific condition.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 標準治療方式（醫療界公認的常規療法）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 看似簡單的詞彙，但在醫療語境下指代公認的治療準則。文中：Brian Wolpin of the Dana-Farber Cancer Institute added that these results support the drug as the new standard of care for patients with advanced pancreatic cancer who have already tried other treatments.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To meet all the necessary requirements or criteria.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 符合所有要求、達成所有條件。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見的職場與生活慣用語，意指達到所有標準。文中：As Rachna Shroff from the University of Arizona Cancer Center mentioned, this study checks all the boxes for what is considered an important and meaningful clinical outcome.

This daily pill targets a specific protein that helps tumors grow, which was previously considered impossible to treat. Clinical trials showed that the drug nearly doubled the survival time for patients compared to traditional chemotherapy. While the drug can cause side effects like skin rashes, it is seen as a major step forward in fighting this deadly disease. Experts hope this approval will lead to more effective treatment options in the future.

quiz.question: According to the clinical trial results mentioned in the article, how did the survival time of patients taking Rasonque compare to those receiving standard chemotherapy?

options.A: It was slightly shorter due to severe side effects.
options.B: It was approximately double the duration of the standard treatment.
options.C: It was exactly six months longer than the standard treatment.
options.D: It showed no significant difference in survival rates.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第三段指出，使用新藥的患者存活期中位數為 13.2 個月，而接受標準化療的患者僅為 6.7 個月，13.2 大約是 6.7 的兩倍。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到新藥副作用較少；選項 C 錯誤，因為 13.2 減去 6.7 等於 6.5，而非 6；選項 D 則與文章數據明顯不符。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the FDA's decision to grant 'expedited approval' for Rasonque?

options.A: The FDA prioritized speed over the safety of the clinical trial participants.
options.B: The drug was approved primarily because a former Senator publicized his experience.
options.C: The FDA recognized the urgent need for better treatments for a highly lethal disease.
options.D: The drug manufacturer pressured the FDA to bypass standard testing protocols.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第二段與第四段，胰臟癌是極致命且難以治療的疾病，FDA 代理局長強調其職責是儘速提供有意義的治療。這暗示加速審核是基於病患的迫切需求。選項 A 無根據，因為試驗結果強勁；選項 B 錯誤，因為藥物審核是基於科學數據而非個人經驗；選項 D 則無任何證據支持。

quiz.question: In the third paragraph, the phrase 'grand slam' is used to describe the new drug. What does this metaphor imply?

options.A: The drug is a significant and impressive success in its field.
options.B: The drug was developed after many failed attempts.
options.C: The drug is expensive and difficult for patients to acquire.
options.D: The drug was approved after a long and complicated legal battle.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在棒球中，「grand slam」（滿貫全壘打）意指一次擊球得分最高，在此處轉喻為醫學上的重大突破與巨大成功。選項 B 雖提及研發過程，但非此詞本意；選項 C 與 D 皆與此詞的正面讚譽語氣不符，且文中並未提及藥物昂貴或法律糾紛。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article?

options.A: The FDA is changing its regulations to make all cancer drugs available sooner.
options.B: Rasonque is the only effective treatment currently available for lung cancer patients.
options.C: Public figures are the most important factor in the approval of new medical treatments.
options.D: The approval of Rasonque represents a major, promising advancement in treating pancreatic cancer.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章全文圍繞著 Rasonque 的核准，強調其如何突破胰臟癌治療的困境，並被專家視為重大進展。選項 A 過度概括，擴及所有癌症藥物；選項 B 錯誤，因為該藥目前針對的是胰臟癌；選項 C 錯誤，公眾關注雖有影響，但核心仍是臨床試驗的強勁數據。
